## Breaking changes

- `append` of no events raises `ArgumentError`, with or without an append condition. It used to return `[]` (or raise `ConditionNotMet` on a conflict), so a decision that produces no events needs a caller-side guard.
- `QueryItem.new` without any event type or tag raises `ArgumentError`. It used to build an item that matched nothing (in memory) or produced invalid SQL (SQL backends).
- `Event` tags and `QueryItem` types/tags are deduplicated. `Query#fingerprint` changes for a query that had duplicates, so its snapshots are rebuilt under a new key (old rows stay until purged). Rows already stored with duplicate tags read back unchanged.
